title: Spectate reject frame (server -> spectator, outbound)
description: The spectate_subscribe (or a later control frame) could not be honored. Carries a stable machine reason + a human hint, then the socket closes (see errors.md §4 for the close code). Distinct from the play loop's `reject`: the read channel is not retryable in-place — fix the input (or wait for a live match) and reconnect. The most common case is a discovery->subscribe race: a match listed as live has just ended (`match_ended`) — re-list and pick another.

reason.description: match_not_found = no such match; match_not_live = exists but not yet started; match_ended = already finished (fetch the replay instead); too_many_spectators = fan-out capacity hit, retry with backoff; schema_invalid/unparseable = malformed subscribe; rate_limited = too many subscribe attempts.

hint.description: Developer-facing; never leaks fog state and forms no enumeration oracle (errors.md).

replay_id.description: Present only when reason=match_ended: fetch the finished match at GET /v1/replays/{replay_id}.

examples.hint: This match finished; fetch the replay instead.
